research_question: SUBOFF 裸艇 LBM 的 tau(松弛/粘度) 与网格分辨率能否解耦? 负阻力出现在 (tau, 网格) 平面的哪一面?

fixed_protocol.hull: DARPA SUBOFF bare hull (L=4.356 m, D=0.508 m, L/D=8.57)
fixed_protocol.collision_model: MRT (D3Q19 multiple-relaxation-time, tensorlbm collide_mrt3d as routed by GeneralSimEngine)
fixed_protocol.domain_note: engine pins hull centre at cx = 0.25*nx, so nx=3L gives 0.25L upstream / 1.75L downstream; lateral half-width 0.35L+0.0583L = 0.408L => blockage = pi*R^2/(0.8166L)^2 = 1.60%
fixed_protocol.initial_field: uniform equilibrium (GeneralSimEngine.setup(), identical construction for every case; no warm start, no field reuse)
fixed_protocol.normalisation: C_T = F_x / (0.5*rho*u^2*S), S = pi*D*L (bare wetted area, anchor caliber); engine samples frontal dpS = 0.5*u^2*pi*R^2 and every sample is rescaled by dpS_front/dpS_wet

AN-SUBOFF.what: DTRC SUBOFF AFF-1 bare-hull tow-tank resistance (Stern et al. 1980 DTRC report; Groves/Huang/Chang 1987; ITTC 7.5-03-02-03), 6 Re ladder
AN-SUBOFF.usage: relative deviation of every simulated C_T from the anchor C_T at the anchor Re nearest to the simulated Re; numbers are read from the artifact, never transcribed by hand

external_anchors.limit_disclosed: anchor Re = 1.16e7..3.54e7; simulated Re_lat = 3*u_lb*N/(tau-0.5) = 480..57600 => simulated Re is 200x..74000x below the anchor band. The deviation column is therefore a CALIBER statement, not an accuracy claim; no <3% band is claimed.

decoupling_identity.statement: In LBM at fixed lattice speed, Re_lat = u_lb*N/nu_lb = 3*u_lb*N/(tau-0.5): tau and N enter only through the product N/(tau-0.5). Hence (tau,N) is not a two-factor design at all; every row of the matrix is a different-Re slice.
decoupling_identity.test: C_T of all 18 cases plotted / regressed against Re_lat; a collapse onto a single curve (|C_T - f(Re_lat)| within the run-to-run window spread) is the numerical signature of the identity.

criteria.C1: >=18 cases with C_T/C_F/C_P tabulated, plus relative deviation (%) vs the AN-SUBOFF anchor C_T
criteria.C2: negative-drag surface registered on the (tau,N) matrix; every boundary cell must have >=1 same-sign 4-neighbour (no single-point extrapolation)
criteria.C3a: same tau across N: relative drift of C_T < 3%  (drift = (max-min)/|value at N=192|)
criteria.C3b: same N across tau: monotonicity decided by machine check (verdict yes/no + evidence row ids)
criteria.C4: 6 significant digits in the numeric band; every number recomputed by 2 independent scripts with different call paths, agreeing to 1e-6
criteria.C5: honest FAIL not falsified: every unmet criterion is reported with the measured gap

stopping_rule: the matrix is run once to completion; no case is re-run or tuned after seeing results (no threshold shopping). Failed/diverged cases are recorded as failures, not replaced.

compute_plan.hardware: loong64 cluster nodes n315/n330 (128 cores each), torch CPU float32; measured ~1.5-2.0 MLUPS per process
compute_plan.budget: 400 steps x 18 cases = 5.3e10 cell-updates; submitted as 6 jobs (one per tau, 3 grid levels each, sequential inside the job)
